name: ShipBoost
tagline: ShipBoost is a launch and distribution platform built for bootstrapped SaaS founders who want more than vanity traffic and dead-directory listings
description: ShipBoost is a launch and distribution platform built for bootstrapped SaaS founders who want more than vanity traffic and dead-directory listings. It helps founders create product listings, improve launch visibility, and increase distribution through curated discovery pages, alternatives pages, and founder-focused exposure opportunities. ShipBoost is designed to help products look more credible, get discovered in the right contexts, and build momentum beyond a single launch day.
